test_version_negotiation_e2e: test the e2e version negotiation flow between a gRPC client and server with full handshake
test_legacy_server_fallback: test that the client falls back to JSON protocol when the server lacks get_server_info
test_min_client_version_rejection: test that the client raises RuntimeError when the server requires a newer client version
test_skip_version_check: test that skip_version_check=True bypasses the server version handshake entirely
test_full_e2e_handshake_query: test the full e2e handshake followed by an inference query on the same gRPC channel
